description: This file defines the 'StagingExtension' class for Twig, a templating engine, acting as a staging area for registering and retrieving functions, filters, node visitors, token parsers, and tests within Twig's environment.

classes.name: StagingExtension
classes.description: A final class used as an internal extension in Twig to manage registration and retrieval of various extension components.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Registers a new TwigFunction, throws exception if function with same name exists.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered TwigFunction objects.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Registers a new TwigFilter, throws exception if filter with same name exists.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered TwigFilter objects.

methods.name: addNodeVisitor
methods.description: Adds a NodeVisitor to the list of visitors.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array of registered NodeVisitor objects.

methods.name: addTokenParser
methods.description: Registers a new TokenParser, throws exception if parser with same tag exists.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array of registered TokenParser objects.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Registers a new TwigTest, throws exception if test with same name exists.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of registered TwigTest objects.
